pretreatment: RCA cleaning (SC-1) to remove organic contaminants and particulates followed by a 1% high-frequency dip for 30 s
evidence: Prior to deposition, Si substrates ( ∼25 mm × 25 mm) were cleaned using the Radio Corporation of America (RCA) standard cleaning (SC-1) to remove organic contaminants and particulates followed by a 1% high-frequency dip for 30 s, which leaves approximately 10 Å of native oxide on the surface.
